summary.text: John Torbett is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives from District 108, which he has represented since 2010, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a business executive and former Gaston County commissioner.

paragraphs.text: John Torbett has been vice president of North Carolina operations for Defense Technologies, Inc. since 2003.
He previously worked as a layout specialist and as CEO of Corrugated Converting.
Torbett served on the Gaston County Board of Commissioners from 2002 to 2010, before taking his House seat in 2010.
